verdicts.verify_by: go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/ -run TestB2Claims_DocsAliasIs404 (artifact below) against head; live: gnokey query vm/qpaths --data '@docs' and vm/qeval --data 'gno.land/r/sys/users.ResolveName("docs")' on https://rpc.gno.land:443, plus curl -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://gno.land/docs
verdicts.tldr: gno.land/docs, a shipped alias serving a 200 page today, becomes a 404 error page once this gate ships
verdicts.details: DefaultAliases maps "/docs" to "/u/docs" (app.go:30), and GetUserView now 404s a name that is neither an address, nor a namespace holding packages, nor resolved by r/sys/users. On gnoland-1 "docs" is none of the three: vm/qpaths '@docs' comes back empty and ResolveName("docs") is (false bool), so /docs and /u/docs answer 404 with the shared "Something went wrong" body for every visitor and crawler until #5760 serves the embedded docs there. The merge base serves the same URL as a 200 profile page, so the flip is this branch's. Fix: hold the gate for names DefaultAliases points at, or land it together with the replacement /docs page.
verdicts.evidence: Head 876762bdf, finder artifact rerun from the file in a scratch worktree: go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/ -run TestB2Claims_DocsAliasIs404 -count=1 -v -> "--- PASS: TestB2Claims_DocsAliasIs404 (0.00s)", i.e. /u/docs is 404 for the stubbed live answers. Merge base 7916d1dd6, my own check: go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/ -run TestJudge14_DocsIsAPageAtBase -count=1 -v -> PASS, both "/u/docs -> 200" and "/docs -> 200" with body "Gnome docs" for the same empty-namespace, no-home-realm answers. Live 2026-09-19: curl https://gno.land/docs -> status=200, <title>gno.land - /u/docs</title>, body "Gnome docs"; gnokey query vm/qpaths --data '@docs' -> "data: " (empty); gnokey query vm/qeval --data 'gno.land/r/sys/users.ResolveName("docs")' -> "(nil *gno.land/r/sys/users.UserData)\n(false bool)". Case space: 200 at base only, 404 at head only.
